name: mailperch-thunderbird
description: Build, test, and release tooling for MailPerch, a Thunderbird email pinning and follow-up extension.

scripts.check: python3 scripts/check_repo.py && python3 scripts/deep_audit.py && python3 scripts/scan_secrets.py
scripts.test: python3 tests/static_checks.py && python3 tests/test_api_schema_contract.py && python3 tests/test_folder_counter_guard.py && python3 tests/test_ui_regressions.py && python3 tests/test_options_controls.py && python3 tests/test_calendar_and_card_actions.py && python3 tests/test_data_integrity_guards.py && python3 tests/test_build_reproducible.py && node tests/model_tests.mjs && python3 tests/sqlite_model_tests.py
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
